terms.comment: Classical lampas, lampadis f., “lamp, torch”, with a modern adjective.

phrases.latin: computātrulum in mēnsā scrīptōriā aperuit, lampadem lēctōriam accendit
phrases.english: he opened the laptop on the desk and switched on the reading lamp
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 124.
